name: Shirokuro Saimin
source:
Kouta strikes back against his bullies with saimin, the power of mind control.
His powers of persuasion give him the ability to do terrible things.

Saimin achieves both the possible and impossible.

Saimin exposes the lies and truths.

Saimin explores the evident and hidden. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109582.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
孝太用催眠术——精神控制的力量反击欺负他的人。他的说服能力让他能够做出可怕的事情。催眠既能实现可能之事，也能实现不可能之事。催眠揭露谎言与真相。催眠探索明面与隐藏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109582.html]DLsite English[/url]]
